convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom('ColorZerolagTriX') which is a custom indicator not available as a built-in MT5 indicator, plus depends on external #include <TradeAlgorithms.mqh> for position management functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, CIsNewBar). The core signal logic (zero-lag TriX crossover) requires manual Python reimplementation of the custom indicator's 5-component weighted TriX calculation.

derived_values.name: Osc1 - Zero-Lag TriX bullish oscillator line (buffer 0)
derived_values.formula: Weighted sum of 5 EMA-TriX components: Factor1*TriX(TriX_period1) + Factor2*TriX(TriX_period2) + Factor3*TriX(TriX_period3) + Factor4*TriX(TriX_period4) + Factor5*TriX(TriX_period5), smoothed by EMA(smoothing)

derived_values.name: Osc2 - Zero-Lag TriX bearish signal line (buffer 1)
derived_values.formula: Signal line of the Zero-Lag TriX oscillator (likely EMA of Osc1 or a smoothed variant)

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars for indicator warmup

other_exits: Long position closed when Osc1 crosses below Osc2 (if BuyPosClose=true)
Short position closed when Osc1 crosses above Osc2 (if SellPosClose=true)

params.description: MM=0.1 with MMMode=LOT means fixed 0.1 lot; if MMMode=PERCENT, it would be deposit fraction

custom_logic_notes: Zero-Lag TriX is a custom indicator combining 5 weighted Triple Exponential Moving Average rate-of-change components (TriX) with factors 0.05/0.10/0.16/0.26/0.43 (summing to 1.0) and periods 8/21/34/55/89 (Fibonacci sequence). The result is smoothed by EMA(15). Signal logic: Osc1[1]>Osc2[1] (was bullish) AND Osc1[0]<Osc2[0] (now bearish crossover from SignalBar perspective) triggers BUY_Open — note the inversion: crossover detected on bar[1] vs bar[0] at SignalBar offset. Entry is gated by BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen flags. Exit by signal reversal gated by BuyPosClose/SellPosClose flags. Uses CIsNewBar class from TradeAlgorithms.mqh for new bar detection. LoadHistory() ensures bar data availability. GlobalVariableDel_ cleans up on deinit.
python_conversion_notes: Must reimplement the ColorZerolagTriX indicator in Python: (1) Calculate 5 TriX components - each TriX is the rate of change of a triple-smoothed EMA: TriX(n) = EMA3(EMA2(EMA1(close,n))) ROC; (2) Weight them by Factor1-5 and sum; (3) Smooth result with EMA(smoothing=15) to get Osc1; (4) Osc2 is the signal line (likely EMA of Osc1, exact period unknown without indicator source - may need to inspect ColorZerolagTriX.mq5); (5) Implement crossover detection on completed bars (SignalBar=1 means use bar[1] vs bar[0] for signal, bar[2] vs bar[1] for previous state). The TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, etc.) wrap standard CTrade with margin/lot calculation and need straightforward Python equivalents. Position sizing with MMMode=LOT is simply fixed lot size.
